name: nat-history-selected-reads-abandoned-branch
description: native-host.ts:1382 native loaded history reads only the selected content and preserves abandoned-branch locators: archived ids are read from a 4096-entry archive (both windows), and in a persisted session whose branch was abandoned the abandoned user entry is not found by a branch search but is read by its bare and by its source-qualified id, and found by an all-session search. (The upstream assertions on untouched/serialized archive records are host-process instrumentation: Go layer, see coverage.)
